album.title: Radif of Persian Music on Setar III

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on E4 and dwells most on E in Nahib. Forud (0:08.7) introduces Cs, D, A, centred on E. The line peaks at Gs4 (422.5 Hz) at 0:07.5. It closes on Cs4, not the tonic (E4 → E4 → E4 → E4 → E4 → Cs4).

theory_fit.name: Farhat interval classes
